irVersion.description: The IR format version. Bumped, with a migration, on every breaking change.

file.description: The source file as the caller named it: relative and with forward slashes in snapshots.

components.description: The module's components, in source order.

exports.description: What the module exports, in source order. Targets keep the same export shape.

types.description: The local type declarations the components' props, events and setup code use, in source order, each name once: the targets that print types copy them into the outputs of the components that use them.

imports.description: The module's imports of other `.uf.tsx` modules, in source order, each with the API the resolver gave for it (ADR-0053). Absent when it imports none.

keys.description: The injection keys the module declares and exports, in source order (ADR-0054).

name.description: The function's name, PascalCase in ASCII letters and digits, and unique in the module without case: every target writes it as an identifier and names the output file by it.

props.description: The members of the props type, in member order: none for a component without props.

propsParameter.description: The props parameter as written. Absent when the component takes no parameter.

types.description: The names of the module's `types` this component's output declares: the declarations its props' types, its events' payloads and its setup code's annotations reach, in source order.

emits.description: The events the component declares with `const emit = defineEmits<{ … }>()` (ADR-0047). Absent when it declares none.

slots.description: The slots the component declares with `const slots = defineSlots<{ … }>()` (ADR-0054).

exposes.description: The local functions the component exposes with `defineExpose({ … })` (ADR-0054).

inheritAttrs.description: Set by `defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })`: no `class` or `style` falls through.

bindings.description: Every binding the component declares, by the start of its span: the props (each destructured prop, or every prop in the object form), the setup's declarations, the `emit` function and the loop variables. Expressions and code refer to them by id.

setup.description: The setup: what the component's body declares and runs before its return, in source order (plan §4.2, ADR-0045). Empty for a component whose body is only its return.

render.description: The returned JSX: one element, or several roots in a fragment.

UfComponent.description: A component: an exported PascalCase function whose last statement returns JSX.

Span.description: A half-open range `[start, end)` of UTF-16 offsets into the source file.

name.description: The name a consumer passes: ASCII letters and digits that every target can declare and read as an identifier, and none a target reserves (`RESERVED_PROP_NAMES`).

optional.description: Whether the member is optional (`label?: string`).

type.description: The member's type annotation as written: the targets that declare inputs print it.

default.description: The default, in the destructured form only: a static value, which references nothing, since Vue hoists defaults out of the component and Angular evaluates them before any input is set. Absent, or explicitly `undefined`, the prop takes it.

binding.description: The binding expressions read the prop through. Absent when the destructured form leaves the prop out; the object form has one for every prop.

Prop.description: A member of a component's props type.

TypeText.description: A type annotation, as written: exactly `source.slice(span.start, span.end)`.

code.description: The source text, exactly `source.slice(span.start, span.end)`: never rewritten in the IR.

refs.description: Each reference to a binding or an allowed global, in source order, without overlap.

Expression.description: An expression the analyser accepted, with every identifier in it resolved (plan §5.4). Targets print it by splicing their own spelling of each reference into the code.

Reference.description: A resolved identifier in an expression.

span.description: What a target replaces with its own spelling of the binding: the identifier; the whole `props.label` in the object form; and the whole `count.value` for a `state`, `derived` or `templateRef` binding, whose value is the only thing code reads (ADR-0045).

shorthand.description: Set for a shorthand property (`{ label }`), which a rewrite must expand to `label: …`.

call.description: Set where the reference is the callee of a call (`save()`, `format(total.value)`): only a `localFn` binding is called, and outside client code it is used only so; client code may also pass one as a call's argument (`setTimeout(tick, 100)`, ADR-0045). A target whose functions are asynchronous there (Qwik's QRLs) awaits the call.

narrowed.description: The paths of the read that a condition around it narrows, where the read relies on it (ADR-0046): set on a read of a prop or of a ref's value only, shortest path first.

later.description: Set where the reference lies in client code that runs later than the code around it (ADR-0048): in a function that code hands to a call that runs it later or never (a timer's or an observer's callback, a promise's `then`, `addEventListener`, `onCleanup`), written in place or held in a local `const` that only such calls are given. No target tracks what it reads while the code around it runs: a `watchEffect` lists only the other reads as its dependencies (`summarizeTracked`).

BindingReference.description: A read of one of the component's bindings.

BindingId.description: A binding's id: its name and the offset where it is declared, `name@offset` (plan §5.3). Unique in a component, and stable for one source, so expressions refer to bindings by it.

span.description: The path, from the reference's start: the reference itself (`selected.value`, `user`, `props.user`) or a member path off it written with `.` or a literal key (`draft.value.email`, `contact.email`, `rows.value[0]`), no `?.` in it.

NarrowedPath.description: A path of a read that a condition around it narrows (ADR-0046), and that the read then uses as narrowed: a member read through `.`, a call's argument, a local's initial value, an operand. The source's TypeScript narrows it there, and a target whose own spelling of the read it does not narrow (a call: `selected()`, `this.user()`; a property in a closure: `props.user`, `userRef.current`) asserts the path present (`selected()!`, `draft().email!`) or reads a narrowed value of its own. Only a template's condition around a handler may narrow a path to fewer kinds than its declared ones without `null` and `undefined` (`typeof`, a discriminant): the analyser rejects such a narrowing in code (UF3031), where no target keeps it.

name.description: The global's name: one of the globals its context may read.

GlobalReference.description: A read of a global every target can reach: in a template expression one of `ALLOWED_GLOBALS` (Angular templates see only the component's members, so its target declares one for each); in setup code one of `PURE_GLOBALS` or, in client code, `CLIENT_GLOBALS` (ADR-0045).

slot.description: The slot's name, as `defineSlots` declares it.

SlotReference.description: `slots.title` as a condition (ADR-0054): whether the parent filled the slot. Only a render expression holds one, never setup code; rendering a slot is a  {@link  SlotOutletNode } .

form.description: `destructured` for an object pattern, `object` for an identifier (ADR-0034).

name.description: The parameter's name, exactly in the object form: the name its uses are written with (`props.label`), which the targets that keep the object form keep too.

type.description: The annotation as written: a reference to a local type, or an object type literal.

PropsParameter.description: How a component declares its props: `({ label, tone = "info" }: Props)` or `(props: Props)`.

type.description: The type argument as written: an object type literal, or a reference to a local type.

events.description: The events, in member order, each name once.

span.description: The declaration, from `const` to its end.

Emits.description: The events a component declares: `const emit = defineEmits<{ change: [value: number] }>()`.

name.description: The name a consumer listens to (`onChange` in the source): camelCase ASCII, which every target spells its own way (ADR-0012).

parameters.description: The payload: the members of the event's named tuple, in order.

span.description: The member that declares the event.

optional.description: Set for an optional member (`value?: number`).

EventParameter.description: A member of an event's named tuple: `value: number` in `change: [value: number]`.

slots.description: The slots, in member order, each name once.

span.description: The declaration, from `const` to its end.

Slots.description: The slots a component declares: `const slots = defineSlots<{ title?: () => any }>()`.

name.description: `default`, or the name of a named slot.

optional.description: Whether the member is optional: every slot is (UF2029), so a parent may leave it empty.

props.description: The props a scoped slot passes, as written: the type of the member's parameter.

functions.description: The exposed `localFn` bindings, in source order.

Exposes.description: What a component exposes with `defineExpose({ focus, clear })` (ADR-0054).

span.description: Where the binding is declared: the destructured name, the props member, the parameter, or the identifier a setup declaration binds.

Binding.description: A name a component declares, which its expressions refer to.

SetupItem.description: What a component's setup declares or runs, in source order (ADR-0045).

initial.description: The initial value: an expression the setup evaluates once, which may read props and the values declared before it. Absent for `ref()`, which starts `undefined`.

refs.description: Each reference in source order, by the start of its span. A `Write`'s value and an `Emit`'s arguments hold references of their own, which follow it in the list; no other references overlap.

Code.description: Code the setup runs (ADR-0045): an expression or a function's body, with every name in it resolved. Like an  {@link  Expression } , its code is exactly `source.slice(span.start, span.end)` and targets print it by splicing their own spelling of each reference; unlike one, it may write state, call `emit` and `nextTick`, and read what only client code may.

CodeReference.description: A resolved name in setup code.

operator.description: `=`, an arithmetic or logical compound assignment operator (`+=`, `??=`, …), or `++` or `--`. Bitwise and shift assignments are not accepted (UF1002).

span.description: The whole assignment or update expression; for a write that is an arrow's expression body, the whole body, its parentheses included (`() => (open.value = !open.value)`).

target.description: What is written: `count.value`, or the variable.

value.description: An assignment's value: its references follow this one in the list. Absent for `++`/`--`.

arrowBody.description: Set where the write is an arrow function's expression body (`() => count.value++`).

narrowed.description: The target, where the operator reads it (`+=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=`, `%=`, `**=`, `++`, `--`) and a condition around the write narrows it present (`if (count.value !== null) count.value += 1`, ADR-0046): one `local` path spanning `target`. A target that reads the written value through a call asserts it (`count()! + 1`).

WriteReference.description: A write of a `state` or `model` binding's value or of a `localVar`: `count.value = 1`, `count.value += step`, `count.value++`, `timer = setInterval(…)` (ADR-0045). A write is a statement of its own: the whole expression of an expression statement, or the whole body of an arrow function.

event.description: The event's name, as `defineEmits` declares it.

span.description: The whole call, from `emit` to its closing parenthesis.

arguments.description: The payload's arguments, in order: their references follow this one in the list.

EmitReference.description: A call of the component's `emit`: `emit("change", count.value)` (ADR-0047). The event is a string literal naming one the component declares.

ApiReference.description: A use of an authoring API inside setup code: only `nextTick` (ADR-0048). The macros and the other APIs are setup items, called at the top level of the body.

call.description: Set where the member is called (`event.preventDefault()`).

EventReference.description: A use of a handler's event parameter, `event.key` or `event.preventDefault()` (ADR-0047): a member every target's event object has (`PORTABLE_EVENT_MEMBERS`), read or called. The parameter is the one a  {@link  Parameter }  marks with `event`.

getter.description: The getter: a function without parameters, pure as a template expression is.

returnType.description: The return type annotation as written, without its colon.

body.description: The body: a block `{ … }`, or an arrow's expression.

expression.description: Set where the body is an arrow's expression rather than a block.

eventControls.description: The leading `preventDefault()` and `stopPropagation()` calls of a handler's body (see  {@link  EventControl } ), in source order: set on a function that handles an event (an inline handler, or a setup function a handler names) when it makes any. The body may make others while the event is dispatched (in an `if` block beside other statements, a `switch` case, after a guard on state), which every target runs in place and codegen's `handlerControls` reads from the body; never one after an `await` or in a function inside it (UF3033).

span.description: The whole function, from `async` or its first parameter to the end of its body.

FunctionCode.description: A function the source writes: a setup function, a handler, a callback or a getter (ADR-0045). Targets print it from its parts: a hoisted handler (Angular's methods) needs them apart, and every other target prints them back as the author wrote them.

name.description: The name of an identifier parameter. Absent for a pattern.

pattern.description: A destructuring pattern (`[first, last]`, `{ id }`), as written. Absent for an identifier.

type.description: The type annotation as written, without its colon.

optional.description: Set for an optional parameter (`label?: string`).

default.description: The default: a static value, which references nothing.

event.description: Set on a handler's event parameter: the DOM interface of its event (`KeyboardEvent`), from its annotation or, unannotated, from the event's own (`DOM_EVENTS`). Code uses it only through  {@link  EventReference } s.

Parameter.description: A parameter of a function the source writes: an identifier or a destructuring pattern, with its type and default. A function's own names are not bindings: code refers to them as written.

code.description: Exactly `source.slice(span.start, span.end)`: its defaults are static.

names.description: The names the pattern binds, each an identifier.

ParameterPattern.description: A destructuring pattern in a parameter: its code, and the names it declares, in order.

condition.description: The `if`'s test when the call is conditional: code that reads only the event.

span.description: The statement that makes the call: the expression statement, or the whole `if`.

EventControl.description: A `preventDefault()` or `stopPropagation()` call on a handler's event (ADR-0047): a statement at the top of the handler's body, or the only statement under an `if` there whose test reads only the event, with no statement before it that may leave the body but guard clauses whose tests read only the event (`if (event.key !== "Enter") return;`, which `handlerControls` of `@unframework/codegen` reads). Qwik runs these synchronously (`preventdefault:click`, `sync$`), apart from the lazily loaded handler.

IdItem.description: `const id = useId()`: a `localConst` binding holding an id unique to the instance (ADR-0049).

ConstItem.description: `const label = …`: a `localConst` binding, evaluated once when the setup runs (ADR-0045).

VariableItem.description: `let timer: number | undefined`: a `localVar` binding (ADR-0045), which client code writes and reads and no template, getter or watched source reads.

form.description: How the source declares it: a function declaration, or a `const` holding an arrow.

sources.description: What it watches: one source, or each element of an array of sources.

array.description: Set for an array of sources (`watch([a, b], …)`): the callback gets arrays of values.

callback.description: The callback: its parameters are the value, the previous value and `onCleanup`.

immediate.description: `immediate: true`: the callback also runs once when the setup does.

post.description: `flush: "post"`: the callback runs after the DOM has updated.

WatchItem.description: `watch(source, (value, previous, onCleanup) => …, options)` (ADR-0048): the callback runs in the browser after the sources change.

WatchSource.description: What a watcher watches: a `state` or `derived` binding, or a getter.

RefSource.description: A `state` or `derived` binding, written as the ref itself: `watch(count, …)`.

GetterSource.description: A getter, `watch(() => step, …)`: a function without parameters, pure as a getter is.

effect.description: The effect: its one parameter, when it has one, is `onCleanup`.

WatchEffectItem.description: `watchEffect((onCleanup) => …)` (ADR-0048): runs in the browser after the component mounts, and again after any value it reads changes.

callback.description: The hook: a function without parameters.

LifecycleItem.description: `onMounted(…)` or `onUnmounted(…)` (ADR-0048): runs in the browser only.

name.description: The model's name, the string literal `defineModel` takes.

default.description: The `default` option: a static value, as a prop's default is.

ModelItem.description: `const open = defineModel<boolean>("open", { default: false })`: a `model` binding (ADR-0054), a prop the parent may bind two ways.

key.description: The local name of the module's key or of an imported one.

ProvideItem.description: `provide(ThemeKey, theme)` (ADR-0054): a value the component's descendants inject.

key.description: The local name of the module's key or of an imported one.

fallback.description: What `inject` gives where no ancestor provides the key.

tag.description: The tag name: an element of the HTML Living Standard in lower case, or, inside an `<svg>`, an SVG element with its own case (`linearGradient`). The namespace follows from the tree: `<svg>` starts SVG, and everything inside it is SVG.

attributes.description: Each attribute of the element, each name set once.

ElementNode.description:
An element: an HTML element such as `

`, or an SVG element inside an `

name.description: The attribute name as HTML spells it (`class`, `for`, `aria-label`), in lower case on an HTML element and with SVG's own case on an SVG element (`viewBox`): an attribute of the element (its own, a global, an ARIA or a `data-*` attribute). Targets map names to their own spellings by it.

value.description: The decoded value. `true` for an HTML boolean attribute (`<input disabled />`), which is on by being present and renders without a value, and only for one. Any other attribute written without a value has the string `"true"`, as in Vue's and React's JSX (`<span aria-hidden>`); SVG has no boolean attributes. A `class` holds one or more class names separated by single spaces, as Vue, Svelte and Angular render it. Like text, a value holds only characters HTML keeps as they are.

StaticAttribute.description: An attribute whose value is known at compile time: `class="card"`, `disabled`.

name.description: As a static attribute's name; never `class` or `style`, which have kinds of their own.

BoundAttribute.description: An attribute bound to an expression, `title={label}`: absent when the value is nullish, and its value otherwise, by the rules for its name (ADR-0037).

ClassAttribute.description: A `class` built from parts (ADR-0038): the rendered class names are the union of the static names, the toggles whose condition holds and the names each dynamic part holds, in no particular order. A `class` with no names renders as no `class` attribute.

value.description: One or more class names separated by single spaces.

StaticClass.description: Class names known at compile time: `"card"` in `class={["card", tone]}`.

ToggleClass.description: One class name, present when its condition is truthy: `{ active: on }`, `on && "active"`.

DynamicClass.description: An expression whose string value holds class names separated by whitespace, or nothing.

StyleAttribute.description: A `style` (ADR-0038): `style="color: red"` or `style={{ color: tone }}`, as declarations. The declarations whose value is present render, in no particular order, so no two of them set the same property. A `style` with none renders as no `style` attribute.

property.description: The CSS property name in lower case (`margin-top`), or a custom property (`--gap`).

value.description: The value as written, trimmed: one CSS value, without `!important`.

StaticStyle.description: A declaration whose value is known at compile time.

BoundStyle.description: A declaration bound to an expression: left out when its value is nullish or `""`.

value.description: The object spread: an expression whose type is one object type the module declares, as a prop, a list's item or a member of one is.

keys.description: The keys the object's type declares, in member order.

nullish.description: Whether the object may be `null` or `undefined` where the spread is, as its type says once the conditions around the spread narrow it: then it renders no key, and the targets read each key through `?.` (`attrs?.title`). A read through `?.` of an object that cannot be nullish is an error on Angular (NG8107), and one through `.` of an object that may be throws.

SpreadAttribute.description: A spread of an object whose keys the analyser knows from its type, `{...attrs}` (ADR-0039). It renders exactly its declared keys, each as a bound attribute would, and a `class` key merges with the element's own `class`.

name.description: The attribute name, as a bound attribute's.

span.description: The member's key in the type.

SpreadKey.description: A key a spread's type declares: an attribute the spread renders.

event.description: The DOM event's name, as `addEventListener` takes it: the source's name without `on` and its option suffix, in lower case (`onDblclick` → `dblclick`).

capture.description: `onClickCapture`: the listener runs in the capture phase.

once.description: `onClickOnce`: the listener runs once, then is removed.

EventAttribute.description: An event listener, `onClick={save}` or `onKeydownCapture={(event) => …}` (ADR-0047): it renders no attribute, and runs in the browser only.

Handler.description: What an event runs: a setup function by name, or a function written in place.

FunctionHandler.description: `onClick={save}`: a `localFn` binding, which runs with the event as its argument.

InlineHandler.description: `onClick={() => count.value++}`: an arrow function, which runs with the event as its argument.

RefAttribute.description: `ref={input}` (ADR-0049): attaches the element to a `templateRef` binding. It renders nothing.

control.description: The control, from its tag and its `type`.

lazy.description: `v-model_lazy`: the value is written on `change`, not on `input`.

number.description: `v-model_number`: the value is parsed as a number.

ModelAttribute.description: `v-model={text.value}` on a form control (ADR-0054): binds the control's value, or its checked state, two ways.

RenderNode.description: A node of the render tree.

value.description: The text exactly as the DOM holds it: after JSX whitespace rules and entity decoding, as every JSX implementation reads it, or a string literal's value. It holds only characters HTML keeps as they are (no carriage return, NUL, lone surrogate, control character or noncharacter). Targets escape it for their own syntax. Two Texts are never adjacent: the analyser merges them.

InterpolationNode.description: An expression rendered as text, `{label}`. Its value is a string or a number, or nothing when nullish: the analyser rejects every other kind of value, which the targets render differently.

branches.description: The branches in order: the first whose condition holds renders, or the final else.

IfNode.description: A conditional, `c ? <A/> : <B/>` or `c && <A/>`, with an else-if chain flattened into its branches. A branch renders when its condition is truthy, as `v-if` decides, never by the value JavaScript's `&&` would give (ADR-0036).

condition.description: The condition: absent on the final else branch.

children.description: What the branch renders: nothing for an empty branch, which only the else may not be.

item.description: The callback's item parameter: a `loopVar` binding.

index.description: The callback's index parameter, when it has one: a `loopVar` binding.

key.description: The `key` of the callback's root, lifted off the element: `key` is no attribute.

body.description: The callback's root element or component, without its `key` (ADR-0053).

component.description: The local name of an imported component, or the name of one of the module's own.

attributes.description: Each attribute, each name set once.

fills.description: What fills the child's slots: the children as the default slot's, then the named ones.

ComponentNode.description: A component element, `<Field label="Name" onClear={reset} />` (ADR-0053): an imported component, one of the module's own, or the component itself.

ComponentAttribute.description: An attribute on a component (ADR-0053, ADR-0054): a prop, a listener of an event the child declares, a model's binding, or a `class`, a `style` (fallthrough) or a `ref` (what it exposes).

PropAttribute.description: A prop passed to a component, `label="Name"` or `label={name}`: a static value is a literal.

event.description: The event's name, as the child's `defineEmits` declares it.

ListenerAttribute.description: A listener of an event a child declares, `onClear={reset}` (ADR-0053): its handler's parameters are the event's payload, never a DOM event.

ModelBindingAttribute.description: `v-model:open={open.value}` on a component: binds a model the child declares (ADR-0054).

slot.description: The child's slot: `default`, or a named slot.

parameter.description: A scoped fill's parameter, whose names are `slotScope` bindings.

children.description: What fills the slot: none for a forwarded one.

forward.description: The parent's own slot this fill passes on, `{{ title: slots.title }}`, with no children.

SlotFill.description: What fills a child's slot (ADR-0054): the children for the default slot, an arrow function in the slot object for a named one, with its parameter for a scoped one, or the parent's own slot passed on.

slot.description: The slot's name, as `defineSlots` declares it.

props.description: The object a scoped slot is called with.

fallback.description: What renders when the parent leaves the slot empty: nothing when empty.

SlotOutletNode.description: Where a component renders a slot, `{slots.title?.()}` or `{slots.item?.({ item })}`, with the fallback after `??` (ADR-0054).

is.description: What chooses the candidate: an expression whose value is one of `candidates`.

candidates.description: The set it chooses from, in source order.

children.description: The children of a tag candidate: none for components, whose content is `fills`.

DynamicNode.description: `<component is={…} />` over a statically known set (ADR-0054): all tags, or all components. Tag candidates take element attributes and children; component candidates take component attributes and fills, each declared by every candidate.

DynamicCandidate.description: A candidate of `<component is>`: a tag, or a component by its local name.

TagCandidate.description: A tag `<component is>` may render: an HTML element's name.

component.description: The local name of an imported component, or the name of one of the module's own.

ComponentCandidate.description: A component `<component is>` may render: a `component` binding's component.

FragmentNode.description: Several root nodes, `<>…</>`: only ever a component's render root.

kind.description: `default` for `export default function Name`, `named` for `export function Name`.

name.description: The exported name: `"default"` for the default export, and an identifier otherwise.

local.description: The name of the component that is exported: one of the module's components.

name.description: The declared name, which the props' types refer to.

exported.description: Whether the source exports it: the outputs export it too.

code.description: The declaration from `interface` or `type` to its end, without `export`: exactly `source.slice(span.start, span.end)`. Targets copy it as written.

TypeDeclaration.description: A top-level `interface` or `type` declaration that a component's props use (ADR-0034).

specifier.description: The specifier as written, which ends in `.uf.tsx`.

file.description: The resolved `.uf.tsx`, relative to the importer, with forward slashes.

api.description: What the resolver returned for the module.

names.description: The names the import binds, in source order.

ModuleImport.description: An import of another `.uf.tsx` module: `import Field from "./Field.uf.tsx"` (ADR-0053). The analyser records the API it resolved, so every target emits from the IR alone (P5, P6).

file.description: The module's file, relative to the importer, with forward slashes.

components.description: The module's components, in source order, its non-exported ones included.

keys.description: The injection keys the module exports, in source order.

ModuleApi.description: The public API of a `.uf.tsx` module, as the resolver returns it (ADR-0053): what a parent reads of its children. It points into another file, so it holds types as text and no spans.

export.description: How the module exports it: as the default, by name, or not at all (a sibling file).

events.description: The events `defineEmits` declares, in member order.

models.description: The models `defineModel` declares, in source order.

slots.description: The slots `defineSlots` declares, in member order.

exposes.description: The names `defineExpose` exposes, in source order.

inheritAttrs.description: `false` where `defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })` turns fallthrough off.

root.description: What the component's render root is: one element, one component, or anything else (a fragment, a conditional, a slot outlet). Fallthrough and Angular's host need it (ADR-0056).

rootTag.description: The root element's tag, when the root is an element.

ComponentApi.description: What a parent reads of a child component (ADR-0053, ADR-0055).

ApiMember.description: A prop or a model of a child's API: its name, its optionality and its type as written.

ApiEvent.description: An event of a child's API: its name and its payload's members, which a target's listener spreads (Angular's tuple payload rule, ADR-0047).
